records.description: Term Loan lower bound encoded as float 140000.01 in 'project_cost_min_inclusive' — an encoding hack for a strict/exclusive boundary (> Rs 1,40,000). Value carries paise precision not present in the real scheme.
records.recommended_resolution: M0 B2: model as explicit exclusive flag (cost_min_inclusive=false, value=140000). Official boundary semantics still to be verified from scheme document.

records.description: UNY beneficiary_interest_rate is a channel-dependent string ('13 (Co-op Banks/Societies); 15 (SFBs)') instead of a scalar. Modeled as conditional on channel_type; applicability rules must be verified.
records.recommended_resolution: Keep conditional model; verify channel-to-rate mapping from UNY policy document.

records.description: ELS repayment_years is a state-dependent string ('12 if repayment has not started; 10 if repayment has started'). Modeled as conditional on repayment_has_started.
records.recommended_resolution: Verify from ELS borrow/repayment terms (S019 ELS policy).

records.description: ELS moratorium_months is a state-dependent string ('Course period + 1 year ... ; up to 6 months ...'). Moratorium depends on course duration which is NOT in the KB (user input or course-family assumption needed, M0 B7).
records.recommended_resolution: Keep string form for the course-period branch; surface as a clarifier.

records.description: ELS max_loan_amount (4,000,000) equals project_cost_max (4,000,000), while financing_percent=90 and the cap rule is 'lesser of Rs 40L or 90% of course fee'. A pure 90% model would cap the loan at 90% of project cost. The stated equality implies the Rs 40L cap dominates; mathematics needs official verification (course fee never in KB).
records.recommended_resolution: M0 B7: engine should compute cap as min(40L, 90% x course_fee) using user-supplied course fee; keep project_cost_max as ELS admission ceiling.

records.description: E002 income-ceiling effective date '2026-01-07' is embedded in rule explanation free-text. No publish/effective metadata exists on the source pages.
records.recommended_resolution: Promote to effective_from=2026-01-07 (done in normalized rule). Verify whether this denotes a revised income ceiling.

records.description: E007 is scoped to 'Skill Development Training' — a program domain OUTSIDE the 5 core credit/loan schemes in this KB. It must not be interpreted as a loan eligibility rule. Retained for context/FAQ use only.
records.recommended_resolution: Keep scope EXTERNAL_DOMAIN; exclude from loan evaluator unless the product defines a Skills domain (post-M1).

records.description: NSFDC Compendium of Schemes (S009): raw JSON marks it 'Secondary/historical'; Excel Source Register (01_Core) marks Authority 'Primary'. Both representations preserved; NOT auto-resolved.
records.recommended_resolution: M0 B1 (recommendation: treat S009 as Secondary/historical; rely on current pages for live parameters).

records.description: KB/Master DB.txt is empty (0 bytes). Source register + scheme master JSON are the operative raw inputs. Empty file preserved unmodified.
records.recommended_resolution: Resolved by design: JSON + Excel are the authoritative raw set; Master DB.txt kept as-is (M0 B4).

records.description: Partner master data (names, states, districts, addresses, coordinates, phone, eligibility conditions, utilisation figures) is NOT ingested. Only partner PDF URLs are registered. Never fabricate partner facts.
records.recommended_resolution: M1.9: define partner schema + documented ingestion gap; partner ingestion recommended in the follow-on milestone (needs official PDF download; team decision required).

records.description: Exact per-scheme document checklists are not present in the corpus. Only the caste certificate requirement is rule-verified (E003). Application/limitation: P1 checklist output must clearly mark documents as indicative.
records.recommended_resolution: Confirm final document list from application forms (S006) during M2 verification.

records.description: The corpus does not state per-activity or per-scheme eligibility. Activity-to-scheme mappings in this KB are UNVERIFIED (sector-level inheritance). Tailoring etc. must NOT be treated as verified eligible without individual confirmation (M2/Gemini).
records.recommended_resolution: M1.6 marks all activity mappings UNVERIFIED; per-activity verification is a follow-on task.

records.description: Two exact-duplicate activity names appear in two sectors each: 'Bicycle Repairing Shops' (Small Industries + Service & Transport) and 'Saw Mills' (Small Industries + Service & Transport). Merged into single activity records carrying both sector_ids; both raw entries preserved in raw JSON.
records.recommended_resolution: Resolved in M1.6: single activity id with multi-sector membership. Also note near-duplicates (see M1_1 audit section 10) left untouched by design.
